description:
### ✨ Improvements

* **Top Toolbar & Suggestions:** match Frosted Glass key opacity in real time, draw uniform circles matching the native Mic button across toolbar & drawer states, add rounded-rectangle (`8dp`) backgrounds for suggestion strip items, remove default vertical suggestion dividers, and preserve View padding on Voice Typing bar.
* **Web Clipboard:** 2-way image clipboard sync (`GET /clipboard/image`, `POST /clipboard/image`, `imageUpdatedAtMs` in `/state`).
